```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican Party is committed to domestic energy independence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States and its neighbors to the North and South have abundant energy resources, both tapped and untapped, traditional and alternative.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Advancing technology has given a more accurate understanding of the nation's enormous energy reserves.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Public officials should encourage responsible development of energy resources across the board.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unlike the current Administration, the Republican Party will not pick winners and losers in the energy marketplace.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party will let the free market and public preferences determine energy industry outcomes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans advocate an all-of-the-above diversified approach to energy sources, taking advantage of all American resources.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An all-of-the-above approach is the best way to advance North American energy independence.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Policies aim at energy security to ensure an affordable, stable, and reliable energy supply for all parts of the country and all sectors of the economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Energy security is intimately linked to national security due to current dependence upon foreign supplies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Some of the hundreds of billions of dollars paid for foreign oil ends up in the hands of terrorist groups that wish to harm the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A growing, prosperous economy and quality of life depend on affordable and abundant domestic energy supplies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
